reuse.why: Adds the new check to the existing guardBankAccountLink wrapper and the link.ts assertion module, which every provider's link request already goes through.

duplication.why: The closed-account rule is written once, and nothing is duplicated.

placement.why: The assertion sits next to assertBankAccountNotLinked in link.ts, and the wrapper calls it before any write, the same way as the existing rule.

scope.why: One helper, one call and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clear, documented, single-purpose helper that follows the established pattern for link preconditions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link methods are wrapped by guardBankAccountLink, which now applies the check.

one_place.where: link.ts assertUpgradingAccountNotClosed, called from guardBankAccountLink for every provider.
